gates.name: Foundation and source of truth
criteria: Specifications and dependency baseline are reproducible

gates.name: Deterministic story core
criteria: Timeline, replay hash, and 1000-seed properties pass
gates.rollback_condition: Any replay mismatch or invalid generated seed

gates.name: Playable 180-second journey
criteria: All inputs, phases, shots, and end state work
gates.rollback_condition: A required phase, input, or end state is unavailable

gates.name: Accessibility and presentation
criteria: Settings, mute, mobile UI, and generated presentation assets pass
gates.rollback_condition: Any supported input or accessibility mode blocks progress

gates.name: Independent acceptance
criteria: Artifact-only SolMax review has zero open S0-S2
gates.rollback_condition: Any open S0, S1, or S2 review finding

gates.name: Public release
criteria: Anonymous HTTPS URL passes a real interaction smoke test
gates.rollback_condition: Public URL or core interaction becomes unavailable

known_risks.description: Contest consent, identity, rights attestation, Seoul attendance, and final submission require the responsible human

evidence.description: Tracked as HUMAN_PENDING in docs/QA.md and Notion; not part of automated public deployment
